title: The Boy Who Changed
summary: Min-Jae confronts Ha-Jun behind the old auditorium with saved security footage. Choosing loyalty over fear, Min-Jae vows to keep the secret. As the Subterranean Quest countdown ticks away, Ha-Jun breaks open the condemned 1920s cellar doors and descends into the ancient demonic chamber below.

panels.action: Wide shot of the condemned Victorian auditorium behind the sports fields; red brick walls covered in overgrown wild ivy and rusted rain gutters.
panels.prose_en: Wide shot of the condemned Victorian auditorium behind the sports fields; red brick walls covered in overgrown wild ivy and rusted rain gutters.
panels.prose_hi: Khel ke maidanon ke peeche nindit victorian sabhagaar ka vistrit drishya; lal int ki deewaren oonche junglee iv aur jung lage barsati naalon se dhaki hui han.

panels.action: Min-Jae stands in the shadow of the brick wall, nervously kicking loose gravel with his scuffed sneakers, holding his phone tightly.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kya wo aayega...?

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae stands in the shadow of the brick wall, nervously kicking loose gravel with his scuffed sneakers, holding his phone tightly.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je int ki deewar ki chhaya mein khada hai, ghabrae hue apne ghise hue sneakers ke saath dhili bajri ko laat maar raha hai, aur apne phone ko kaskar pakad raha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun rounds the brick corner with his hands in his uniform pockets, footsteps steady and silent on the overgrown path.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rounds the brick corner with his hands in his uniform pockets, footsteps steady and silent on the overgrown path.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni vardi ki jebon mein haath daalkar int ke kone ka chakkar lagata hai, oonche raste par uske kadam sthir aur shant han.

panels.action: Min-Jae looks up sharply: 'Tum aa gaye.' / Ha-Jun: 'Tumne note bheja tha. Kya baat karni hai?'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein aa gaye.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae looks up sharply: 'Tum aa gaye.' / Ha-Jun: 'Tumne note bheja tha. Kya baat karni hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je teji se upar dekhta hai: 'tum aa gaye.' / ha-jun: 'tumne note bheja tha. kya baat karni hai?'.

panels.action: Min-Jae's hands shake slightly as he taps his smartphone screen: 'Bureau ke aane se pehle maine security backup copy kar liya tha.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Maine security footage save kar liya tha, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's hands shake slightly as he taps his smartphone screen: 'Bureau ke aane se pehle maine security backup copy kar liya tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Apne smartphone ki screen par tap karte samay min-je ke haath halke se kampate han: 'buro ke aane se pehle maine security backup copy kar liya tha.'

panels.action: Close-up on phone screen: A grainy, terrifying video of Ha-Jun leaping from the library window and materializing the glowing purple gauntlet in mid-air.
panels.prose_en: Terrifying video of Ha-Jun leaping from the library window and materializing the glowing purple gauntlet in mid-air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka library ki khidki se chhalang lagane aur madhya hawa mein chamakte baingani gauntlet ko moort roop dene ka bhayanak wedio.

panels.action: Min-Jae looks directly into Ha-Jun's eyes: 'Tum teesri manzil se kood gaye aur ek kharoch tak nahi aayi. Aur tumhara haath... wo insaani nahi tha.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Wo haath... insaani nahi tha.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae looks directly into Ha-Jun's eyes: 'Tum teesri manzil se kood gaye aur ek kharoch tak nahi aayi. Aur tumhara haath... wo insaani nahi tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je sidhe ha-jun ki aankhon mein dekhta hai: 'tum teesri manjil se kood gaye aur ek kharch tak nahin i. aur tumhara hath...vo insaan nahin tha.'

panels.action: Dead autumn leaves swirl around their feet in the cold wind; a heavy, solemn silence falls between the two students.
panels.prose_en: Dead autumn leaves swirl around their feet in the cold wind; a heavy, solemn silence falls between the two students.
panels.prose_hi: Thandi hawa mein mrit patjhad ke patte unke pairon ke charon or ghumte han; donon chhatron ke beech ek bhari, gambhir chuppi chha ​​jati hai.

panels.action: Kuro's telepathic hiss from Ha-Jun's shadow: 'Iski memory wipe kar do. Ek blood hex iske dimaag se kal ki saari yaadein mita dega.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Iski memory mita do! Khatra mat lo!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's telepathic hiss from Ha-Jun's shadow: 'Iski memory wipe kar do. Ek blood hex iske dimaag se kal ki saari yaadein mita dega.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki chhaya se kuro ki telepathic fusfusahat: 'iski memory wipe kar do. ek khoon iske dimag se kal ki sari yaadein mita dega.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun firmly closes his eyes in internal refusal: 'Nahi, Kuro. Jab sab mujhe maarte the, tab yahi akela tha jo meri chot par patti lagata tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae mera dost hai. Main use nuksan nahi pahunchaunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun firmly closes his eyes in internal refusal: 'Nahi, Kuro. Jab sab mujhe maarte the, tab yahi akela tha jo meri chot par patti lagata tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne aantarik inkar mein dridhta se apni aankhen band kar lin: 'nahin, kuro. jab sab mujhe maarte the, tab yahin akela tha jo meri chot par patti lagata tha.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, tone deep and solemn: 'Min-Jae... agar sach jaan gaye, toh tumhari aam zindagi khatam ho jayegi.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sach jaan kar tumhari aam zindagi khatam ho sakti hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward, tone deep and solemn: 'Min-Jae... agar sach jaan gaye, toh tumhari aam zindagi khatam ho jayegi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aage badhta hai, swar gehra aur gambhir: 'min-jaye... agar sach jaan gaye, to tumhari aam jindagi khatm ho jaegi.'

panels.action: Min-Jae doesn't flinch: 'Teen saal se main buzdil ban kar dekhta raha. Kal tumne ek monster se meri jaan bachai. Tum chahe jo bhi ho... main tumhara dost hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Tum chahe jo bhi ho... main tumhara dost hoon.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae doesn't flinch: 'Teen saal se main buzdil ban kar dekhta raha. Kal tumne ek monster se meri jaan bachai. Tum chahe jo bhi ho... main tumhara dost hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je jhijhakte nahin han: 'teen saal se main buzdil ban kar dekhta raha. kal tumne ek monster se meri jaan bachai. tum chahe jo bhi ho...main tumhara dost hun.'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's guarded expression melts; a rare, genuine warm smile appears on his face for the first time in seven years.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main akela nahi hoon...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's guarded expression melts; a rare, genuine warm smile appears on his face for the first time in seven years.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki sanrakshit abhivyakti pighal gai; saat varshon mein pehli baar unke chehre par ek durlbh, vastavik garmjoshi bhari muskan dikhai deti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his right hand; tiny, harmless violet sparks of mana dance playfully across his fingertips like fireflies.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises his right hand; tiny, harmless violet sparks of mana dance playfully across his fingertips like fireflies.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna dahina haath uthata hai; man ki chhoti, hanirahit baingani chingari juganuon ki tarah uski ungaliyon par chanchalta se nritya karti hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae's glasses reflect the glowing purple sparks in childlike wonder: 'Yeh... yeh kya hai?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yeh jaadu hai kya...?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's glasses reflect the glowing purple sparks in childlike wonder: 'Yeh... yeh kya hai?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ka chashma bachchon jaise aashcharya mein chamakti baingani chingari ko darshata hai: 'ye... yeh kya hai?!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Mere bade bhai Tae-Jun... unka khoon mere andar jaag utha hai. Aur wo abhi bhi zinda hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhaiya ka khoon jaag gaya hai. Wo zinda hain, Min-Jae.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Mere bade bhai Tae-Jun... unka khoon mere andar jaag utha hai. Aur wo abhi bhi zinda hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'mere bade bhai taaye-jun... unka khoon mere andar jaag utha hai. aur woh abhi bhi jinda han.'.

panels.action: A sharp holographic chime rings in Ha-Jun's vision: [TIME REMAINING: 01:45:00] flashing neon-yellow.
panels.prose_en: A sharp holographic chime rings in Ha-Jun's vision: [TIME REMAINING: 01:45:00] flashing neon-yellow.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki drishti mein ek tej holographic jhankar bajti hai: [shesh samay: 01:45:00] niyan-pili chamakti hui.

panels.action: Ha-Jun winces, clutching his chest as his sovereign core sends a burning pulse through his collarbone.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Waqt bohot kam bacha hai...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun winces, clutching his chest as his sovereign core sends a burning pulse through his collarbone.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni chhati ko pakadkar hansta hai kyonki uska samprabhu core uske collerbon ke madhyam se ek jalti hui naadi bhejta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun points toward two angled, rusted iron cellar storm doors embedded in the stone foundation of the auditorium.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wahan neeche... koi cheez mere khoon ko bula rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points toward two angled, rusted iron cellar storm doors embedded in the stone foundation of the auditorium.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sabhagaar ki patthar ki neenv mein jade do koniy, jung lage lohe ke tahkhane ke toofani darwajon ki or ishara karta hai.

panels.action: Thick black frost coats the massive industrial chain and padlock binding the cellar doors, cold demonic vapor seeping out.
panels.prose_en: Thick black frost coats the massive industrial chain and padlock binding the cellar doors, cold demonic vapor seeping out.
panels.prose_hi: Moti kali thandh ne vishal audyogik shrinkhala aur tahkhane ke darwajon ko bandhane wale taale ko dhak diya hai, thandi rakshasi bhaap bahar ris rahi hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae inspects the doors: 'Yeh 1920s ka basement lab tha. Pachaas saal pehle ek ajeeb hadse ke baad isse permanently seal kar diya gaya tha!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Pachaas saal se yeh band hai! Kehte hain yahan koi nahi bacha tha!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae inspects the doors: 'Yeh 1920s ka basement lab tha. Pachaas saal pehle ek ajeeb hadse ke baad isse permanently seal kar diya gaya tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne darwazon ka nirikshan kiya: 'ye 1920 ke dashak ka basement lab tha. pachas saal pehle ek ajeeb hadse ke baad ise permanent seal kar diya gaya tha!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun grips the heavy hardened steel padlock; with a single casual twist of his bare wrist, the thick shackle shears in half like plastic.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips the heavy hardened steel padlock; with a single casual twist of his bare wrist, the thick shackle shears in half like plastic.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bhari kathor steel padlock ko pakadta hai; uski nangi kalai ke ek aakasmik mod ke sath, plastic ki tarah aadhi moti hathkadi wali canchi.

panels.action: Min-Jae stares at the severed padlock shackle with wide eyes: 'Okay... main tumse kabhi panja nahi ladaunga.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Okay... panja ladane ka plan cancel.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae stares at the severed padlock shackle with wide eyes: 'Okay... main tumse kabhi panja nahi ladaunga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je chaudi aankhon se kate taale ki bedi ko dekhta hai: 'thik hai... main tumse kabhi panja nahin ladunga.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls both heavy iron doors upward with a grinding metallic groan, breaking decades of rusted seal.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls both heavy iron doors upward with a grinding metallic groan, breaking decades of rusted seal.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun donon bhari lohe ke darwajon ko dhatvik karah ke saath upar ki or khinchta hai, jisse dashkon se lagi jung lagi seal toot jaati hai.

panels.action: A freezing blast of ancient air, purple miasma, and glowing violet dust particles rushes out of the dark opening into their faces.
panels.prose_en: A freezing blast of ancient air, purple miasma, and glowing violet dust particles rushes out of the dark opening into their faces.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin hawa, baingani miyasma, aur chamakti baingani dhul ke kanon ka ek jama dene wala visfot andhere se nikalkar unke chehre par aa jata hai.

panels.action: Looking down: An ancient stone spiral staircase winds down endlessly into deep, shadowy subterranean chambers carved into bedrock.

dialogue.text: University ke neeche... ek sadiyon purana shaitan ka mandir tha.

panels.prose_en: Looking down: An ancient stone spiral staircase winds down endlessly into deep, shadowy subterranean chambers carved into bedrock.
panels.prose_hi: Niche dekhne par: ek prachin patthar ki sarpil sidhiyan chattan mein khude hue gahre, chhayadar bhumigat kakshon mein antaheen roop se neeche ki or jaati han.

panels.action: Kuro solidifies on Ha-Jun's shoulder, eyes ablaze: 'Yeh jagah university banne se hazaron saal pehle se yahan maujood hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh jagah university se bhi hazaron saal purani hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro solidifies on Ha-Jun's shoulder, eyes ablaze: 'Yeh jagah university banne se hazaron saal pehle se yahan maujood hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ke kandhe par jam jata hai, aankhen chamakti han: 'ye jagah university banne se hajaron saal pehle se yahan maujood hai.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun turns to Min-Jae: 'Tum upar darwaze par nazar rakho. Agar Bureau ke Hunter aayein, toh turant bhaag jana.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Upar dhyan rakhna. Koi aaye toh turant bhaagna.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns to Min-Jae: 'Tum upar darwaze par nazar rakho. Agar Bureau ke Hunter aayein, toh turant bhaag jana.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun min-je ki or mudta hai: 'tum upar darvaje par nazar rakho. agar bureau ke hunter aayein to turant bhag jana.'

panels.action: Min-Jae picks up a heavy rusted iron pipe from the ground, nodding resolutely: 'Main yahin hoon. Zinda wapas aana.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Main nazar rakhunga. Zinda wapas aana, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae picks up a heavy rusted iron pipe from the ground, nodding resolutely: 'Main yahin hoon. Zinda wapas aana.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je jameen se ek bhari jung laga hua lohe ka pipe uthata hai aur dridhta se sir hilata hai: 'main yahin hun. jinda wapas aana.'.

panels.shot: first step into the subterranean abyss cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes his first step down into the pitch-black stone staircase; his irises ignite with radiant, commanding violet demonic fire: 'Chalo.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chalo, Kuro. Asli khel ab shuru hota hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes his first step down into the pitch-black stone staircase; his irises ignite with radiant, commanding violet demonic fire: 'Chalo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna pehla kadam gahre kale patthar ki sidhi par rakhta hai; uski aankhon ki putli diptiman, baingani rakshasi agni se prajvalit hoti hai: 'chalo.'
